sources.scope: All 64,277 observations from the 1,585-page 2005 elected samiti-member PDF. Raw cells, source codes, heading context and geometry are preserved in samiti_2005_source_fields_json. Decoded names are separately labelled unreviewed candidates, not canonical identities. Reviewed category mappings preserve the unknown caste axis of woman-only labels. Vacancy and unopposed notices are separate statuses. All 13 repeated seat-key groups remain, including three conflicting pairs; no automatic deduplication or winner inference.

sources.scope: Completed enumerated-query snapshot: all 59,021 GP queries have complete pagination and yield 743,685 source reservation observations. The 2,355 TLS-related fetch failures were recovered with certificate verification enabled. All 714,784 observations of the preceding native checkpoint are preserved with no changed values, and every query selection matches the enumerated frame. The first column is labelled GP code despite within-GP ordinal-looking values; ward identity remains unadjudicated. Published totals use different reporting scopes, so complete query-frame coverage does not establish a complete statewide seat denominator. See parsed/20260913T025923Z/recovery_reconciliation.json under the GP-ward source root.
